query: Which quasi-experimental designs (staggered rollouts, eligibility thresholds, IVs, synthetic controls) best identify causal effects of English-in-education policy changes?

response.query: Which quasi-experimental designs (staggered rollouts, eligibility thresholds, IVs, synthetic controls) best identify causal effects of English-in-education policy changes?
response.answer: Difference-in-differences and regression discontinuity designs best identify causal effects of English-in-education policy changes. These designs control for confounding factors and leverage policy rollout timing.
